name: dsh-jev-guardrails
description: Jev-backed guardrails and verification for LLM apps, plus a thin DeepSeek Harness plugin.

scripts.check: npm run check --workspace @codebam/jev-guardrails && npm run check --workspace @codebam/dsh-jev-guardrails
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:lib: npm run build && npm run test --workspace @codebam/jev-guardrails
scripts.pack:dry: npm run build && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @codebam/jev-guardrails && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @codebam/dsh-jev-guardrails
